property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, the correct contract version reverts the whole transfer call if any individual external transferFrom call fails (i.e. c.transfer(...) never returns true when a callee call reverts), whereas the mutant ignores failing external calls and will return true even when an external call reverted; the test fuzzes inputs and uses a helper that can be toggled to revert to expose this difference.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so failures of the call no longer revert the function, changing observable return when a callee call would fail.
